questions.question: 20% of this IPO's money is an offer for sale. Where does that part of the money go?

choices.text: Into the company, to build new factories.
To the existing owners who are selling their shares.

questions.explanation: In an offer for sale, existing owners sell shares they already hold, so the money goes to them. Only the fresh issue, ₹88.01 crore here, reaches Wiscon Industries Limited.

questions.question: Sales went from ₹3.21 crore in FY24 to ₹196.87 crore in FY26, which is 682.6% a year. How would you describe that?
questions.explanation: 682.6% a year is healthy growth: Wiscon Industries Limited's customers are buying more each year.
